businessGoal: Enable visitors to view full product details before purchasing

scenarios.goal: Verify that the product detail page is displayed when a product is clicked from the overview or category page.
Verify that the correct product information (image, name, description, price, category badge, brand badge) is shown on the product detail page.
Verify that a section with related products is displayed below the main product information on the product detail page.
Verify that each related product is clickable and navigates to its respective detail page.
